label: Decisión crítica
prompt: Using the attached Cartera de Ruta direction as the locked visual world, create a HIGH-FIDELITY desktop web app north-star composition, 1440x900, for Supply Control MCP. Structure: compact header; large critical-situation briefing ticket showing one high-risk material, 14-day coverage, deterministic recommendation and Analizar riesgo action; below it a three-column operations board with risk queue, central recommendation dossier as sequential detachable coupons and live MCP evidence inspector; slim footer status strip for local service, Render remote service, tool count, latency and last JSON-RPC method. Preserve warm paper, carrier navy, signal red, carbon purple, perforated seams, barcode and stamp accents, condensed headings, sans body, mono evidence. Authentic Spanish UI copy and synthetic supply items. Status combines text and icon. Minimal radius, accessible contrast, no gradients, no generic KPI dashboard, no map, no airplane overload. Emphasize decision-first triage, one dominant focal incident and handoff to auditable proof.
